arStrings.szText: The {c_highlight}Prime Evil Powers{/c} are at your fingertips. Choose a {c_highlight}Soul Splinter{/c} to capture and harness the remnants of their evil.
{hotkey:Seasonal_Panel} Preview each {c_highlight}Prime Evil's{/c} power before deciding whose {c_highlight}Soul Splinter{/c} you will wield.

Preview each {c_highlight}Prime Evil's{/c} power in the {icon:Marker_Season_Green_font, 2.0} Seasons tab within the {hotkey:Equippables} Character menu before deciding whose {c_highlight}Soul Splinter{/c} you will wield.
The choice is yours. {c_red}Warning: You will be bound to your Prime Evil for some time.{/c}
A {c_highlight}Prime Evil's{/c} power will have an additional bonus effect for specific {c_highlight}War Plan{/c} activities.
